tools.name: Paintbrush
tools.summary: A handle with a tuft of hair or fibre that puts paint, glaze, slip or limewash on a surface.

tools.name: Burin
tools.summary: A steel cutter with a square or lozenge shaft that cuts lines into metal or wood.

tools.name: Chef's knife
tools.summary: A broad kitchen knife with a curved edge for slicing, dicing and mincing.

tools.name: Crucible
tools.summary: A heat-proof pot in which metal or glass melts before it is poured.

tools.name: Drawloom
tools.summary: A hand loom with a second set of cords that lift single warp threads, for figured silks.

tools.name: Electrolytic bath
tools.summary: A tank of metal-salt solution with two poles; a direct current moves metal from one pole onto the part.

tools.name: Etching press
tools.summary: A roller press with a steel bed and felt blankets that pushes damp paper into the grooves of an inked plate.

tools.name: Grill
tools.summary: A grate over glowing charcoal, wood or gas that cooks food with direct radiant heat.

tools.name: Hat block
tools.summary: A wooden form in the shape of a head or a crown, on which wet felt or straw is stretched and dried.

tools.name: Immersion circulator
tools.summary: A heater and pump that hold a water bath at a set temperature to within 0.1 °C.

tools.name: Injection moulding machine
tools.summary: A machine that melts plastic pellets and forces the melt into a closed steel mould.

tools.name: Kiln
tools.summary: A heat-proof chamber that fires clay, glaze, glass or enamel at 600 to 1400 °C.

tools.name: Loom
tools.summary: A frame that holds warp threads under tension so that weft threads can pass through them.

tools.name: Oven
tools.summary: A closed, heated chamber that cooks, dries or cures with hot air.

tools.name: Plaster mould
tools.summary: A mould of plaster of Paris that pulls water out of slip or soft clay, so that a skin of clay forms on its wall.

tools.name: Potter's wheel
tools.summary: A turning disc on which a potter throws, trims or bands a round pot.

tools.name: Printing press
tools.summary: A machine that presses inked type, a block or a stone onto paper or cloth.

tools.name: Rose engine lathe
tools.summary: A lathe whose head rocks against a cam, so that the cutter engraves repeated patterns (guilloché) in metal.

tools.name: Printing screen
tools.summary: A fine mesh on a frame with a stencil; a squeegee pushes ink through the open parts of the mesh.

tools.name: Smokehouse
tools.summary: A closed room or box in which food hangs in the smoke of a slow wood fire.

tools.name: Spit
tools.summary: A long rod that holds meat and turns it in front of or above a fire.

tools.name: Steamer
tools.summary: A basket of bamboo or metal with holes, over boiling water, that cooks food in the steam.

tools.name: Knitting frame
tools.summary: A machine with a row of needles that knits a flat, shaped panel of cloth.

tools.name: Timber formwork
tools.summary: A temporary mould of boards into which wet concrete is poured; the grain of the boards stays on the concrete.

tools.name: Welding torch
tools.summary: A torch or an arc electrode that melts the edges of two parts so that they join.

tools.name: Whipping siphon
tools.summary: A steel bottle that is filled with nitrous oxide and pushes a liquid out as a foam.

tools.name: Wok
tools.summary: A deep, round-bottomed steel pan for fast cooking over a very hot flame.

tools.name: Wood-fired kiln
tools.summary: A kiln with a firebox for wood; the ash in the flame settles on the pots and melts into a glaze.
